profile.summary: riadhchtara is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Express.js internals. Their contributions focus on refining routing logic, improving API design, and maintaining framework compatibility. While their work is deeply technical and narrowly concentrated on Express.js, it demonstrates strong problem-solving skills in backend development, particularly around URL parameter matching, method signature exposure, and legacy feature management. No evidence of frontend development or broader JavaScript ecosystem involvement is present in their contributions.

Modified `Router#match()` signature from `(req[, i])` to `(method, url[, i])` to make it public and more flexible (PR #3)
Renamed JSONP callback to improve clarity and maintain compatibility (PR #4)
Updated Express version in PR #5, referencing issue #1140, indicating involvement in release management
All PRs reference GitHub issues (#1115, #944, #1190) showing structured problem-solving and issue resolution
